5.eng-name: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: Rapporté par Umm Hani’ bint Abu Talib : Le jour de la Conquête (de La Mecque), le Messager d’Allah (ﷺ) a accompli la prière surérogatoire du Duha en huit Rak’ah, en saluant après chaque deux Rak’ah

chapter.ara-name: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى
chapter.eng-name: What was narrated concerning (voluntary) Prayers at night and during the day are two by two
